title: Panel with a single notice

feedback:
Many issues here.  First, the processing messages appear at the top of the screen, then the modal popup switches them dimmed to the bottom of the screen.  That isn't consistent where only dimming occurs, that is actually moving the text on the main screen.  
Right and left arrows for Tab use are indicated, however the opposite of Tab which is Shift-Tab doesn't work.  It is expected to accompany Tab and move the selection in the backwards direection.
Other choice options that you've given me have many character options to quit like Q or ESC, this one doesn't appear to.  There should be a keyboard key which allows a simple quit (which would take the default option).
Regarding the press any key to stop/pause the countdown timer, I never asked for a message stating that the countdown was paused.  This is obvious when you remove the countdown, there should not be a message stating that the timer was paused; this implies that it might resume, which it will not, hence all options should NOT include status on the countdown at all.
Otherwise this is good.

feedback: Same as previous - pause should never be displayed anywhere, it actually is stop, and is an internal state which is already shown to the user when the countdown goes away you know that it is stopped.
title: The same modal before the read (four option notices)

feedback:
The selection list should for the purpose of the prototype be titled What? How? Why?  and those can be the defaults, however those should be parameters so that each consumer of this interface would be able to set the headings.  I should also state that a consumer of this surface may not have the 3 parts to the choice, so should auto-adapt downwards to 2 and 1 depending on the use.
Addition of the 3rd right most column is good, however you didn't adapt the overall modal window size inline with the wider text requirements.  I expect that there is some mimimal auto-detection of how much text that the pop-up window needs to display which would determine automatically its size.  This comment is generic to all of the pop-up modal windows.  I'm thinking something like 3 predefined sizes/ratios of the terminal: small, medium, large.
The placement of the Continue and Select buttons is not consistent across the various prototypes.  This is the sort of thing that needs to happen in the usage, you can't be flipping these buttons back and forth between uses.  Something like cancel, or continue, or OK should have consistent placement.  Custom messages would depend heavily on what the usage is.[D[D[D[D[D[D[D
